arguments.value: This amendment to the Wireless Content License Agreement Number 12965, dated as of December 16, 2004 and previously amended on November 11, 2005 and March 27, 2006, is between Fox Mobile Entertainment, Inc., as Administrator for Twentieth Century Fox Film Corporation, and Glu Mobile Inc. It extends the license term for the listed properties—Robots, Kingdom of Heaven, Mr. and Mrs. Smith, In Her Shoes, Idiocracy (Oww My Balls), and Ice Age II—so their rights continue through March 31, 2008, while the overall term otherwise expired on December 31, 2006. It also updates Glu Mobile Inc.’s notice information by replacing the named contact with "General Counsel" and removing the prior email address. All other terms of the agreement remain unchanged. The source does not state a governing law.
